findings.issue: NOTATION_RECEIVERS omits `→ₐc[` (BialgHom) and `→ₗ.[` (LinearPMap). In `_top_level_notation_receiver`, `A →ₐc[R] B` fails `→ₐ[` (third char is `c`) and `X →ₗ.[ℝ] X` fails `→ₗ[` (third char is `.`); both then hit `→` in TOP_LEVEL_CONNECTIVES and return None, and `_binder_has_type`'s head regex fails because the type is not spelled `BialgHom`/`LinearPMap`. Missed in-tree instances, none of which appear in the baseline: TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/Basic.lean under `namespace TauCeti`/`namespace BialgHom`, all `(φ : A →ₐc[R] B)` — toCoalgHom_toLinearMap:49, coe_coalgHom_toLinearMap:55, algHom_comp_convMul_ofConv:61, convMul_comp_coalgHom_ofConv:73, algHom_comp_antipode_id_ofConv:86, id_antipode_comp_coalgHom_ofConv:96, toLinearMap_comp_antipode:107, map_antipode:141; TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Resolvent/Unbounded.lean under `namespace TauCeti`(80)/`namespace LinearPMap`(84), all `(A : X →ₗ.[ℝ] X)` — IsResolventAt:99, resolventSet:137, exists_isResolventAt_of_mem:154, resolvent:168, isOpen_resolventSet:356; TauCeti/Analysis/Normed/Operator/LinearPMap/Shift.lean under `namespace TauCeti.LinearPMap`(26), all `(A : X →ₗ.[R] X)` — subScalar:32, subScalar_domain:37, subScalar_apply:43, subScalar_zero:52, subScalar_subScalar:57. summary: The notation table is still incomplete: `→ₐc[` (BialgHom) and `→ₗ.[` (LinearPMap) are absent, so 18 declarations that recreate those Mathlib namespaces under `namespace TauCeti` with explicit receivers are invisible to the lint and missing from the regenerated baseline — the baseline is therefore not the census the PR claims, and new violations of the same shape would pass the ratchet.
